recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-15649; any future change to Bundle uniqueness semantics should use a new work-group decision rather than reverting to the older literal STU3 expression.
issue_request: FHIR-15649 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 technical correction asking that bdl-7 evaluate only entries with a populated fullUrl before comparing fullUrl plus resource.meta.versionId.
initial_application: Jira records the change as auto-approved and applied in SVN revision 13339. The original SVN patch is not present in the current git history, but the Bundle StructureDefinition source introduced during the later source rework already included entry.where(fullUrl.exists()), showing that the seed correction was carried forward.
additional_context: Bundle is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later published bdl-7 decisions intentionally changed the literal STU3 expression: FHIR-18284 handled history-delete entries without resources, FHIR-39476 handled absent meta.versionId values, and FHIR-31986 narrowed the rule to entries where resource is present and added a delimiter. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml bdl-7 expression uses entry.where(fullUrl.exists() and resource.exists()), so it includes the seed's required fullUrl filter while preserving later corrections.
